posts.text: Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway, Arden fills a field in the north, and the debate asked both of them for real costings. Only one of those three things tells me something about my job prospects. #VeloriaVotes
Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it prosperity. Ask the farmers in the north what diesel and fertiliser cost this season before you buy that line. #Veloria #Election

Two numbers from tonight that deserve a second look. Ostrand touts the Kessa–North highway as proof of prosperity. Fine, but what does it cost per family, and over how many years? Arden promises 200,000 jobs. Same question: what is the costing? Ask both for the arithmetic before you cheer either.

Two stories today: VBC on the Kessa–North highway opening, Kito TV on the first debate and the costings questions both candidates faced. Before sharing, check the source and the numbers. Want to see the debate costings? Ask the moderators' fact sheet or the election commission's site. #VeloriaVotes

Watched the debate tonight. Arden's 200,000 jobs sound great, but nobody on that stage explained how they'd be paid for. Ostrand dodged the inflation question too. Both need to answer the costings. #Veloria #Election

Saw the highway opening on VBC and the debate on Kito TV tonight. Roads are good, but my grocery prices are still bruising my wallet. Both of them need to show me the numbers. As my mother said: a promise is a loan.

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway = 'new era of prosperity' lmao. Arden promising 200k jobs with zero costings = also cringe. Two weeks left and I still don't know who to trust. Someone pls convince me

Finally a new highway from Kessa to the North. My cab will thank the president, the suspension definitely won't. Ostrand's debate answer on inflation was solid though, let's see what the costings say. #Veloria
Fuel up 40% and they want us to keep 'trusting the process'. Ask any farmer up north what diesel and fertiliser cost this season. Numbers don't lie, ribbon-cutting does. #Veloria #Election

Unity Party says Arden's plan doubles VAT on food? Before anyone shares, check the actual plan text on the Civic Front site and the election commission's costings. A promise is a loan, and so is a rumour. #VeloriaVotes
posts.orig_text: Saw the highway opening on VBC and the debate on Kito TV tonight. Roads are good, but my grocery prices are still bruising my wallet. Both of them need to show me the numbers. As my mother said: a promise is a loan.

posts.text: Fact-check day 2: VeriCheck says Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' claim is built on a peak month. Also: economists estimate a ~2% of GDP gap in his plan. Read the checks yourself before sharing anything. #VeloriaVotes
Day 2 of 14 and the highway debate is already old news. Me, I just want to know what the Kessa-North road costs per family before I cheer. Show me the numbers, both of you. #Veloria

Fact-check says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure is a peak-month number. Fine. But the same check says the plan leaves a ~2% of GDP gap. That's the number I want both camps to answer for. #VeloriaVotes

Watched the debate tonight and my head hurts. Arden's 200k jobs sounds great but where's the money coming from? Ostrand gave me nothing on inflation either. Hospital's still short-staffed, so I care about who actually funds health. Show me the numbers before the vote.

Two weeks out, and the VeriCheck note is useful: the VAT claim is false, the fuel figure cherry-picks a peak month, and there's still a ~2% of GDP gap in Arden's plan. Ostrand's highway needs its cost per family too. Ask both campaigns for the full arithmetic before you pick a side.
Two weeks out and both camps are still selling vibes over costings. Ribbon-cutting isn't a plan, and 200k jobs isn't a plan either. Show me the math or stop asking me to pick a side. #VeloriaVotes

VBC is airing a 'recording' of Arden with 'questions raised' and no provenance. Before this spreads: who made it, when, and has anyone verified it? The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Wait for an independent check, not a clip. #VeloriaVotes

VBC's 'questions raised' clip on Arden is 30 seconds with zero context on where it came from. Wait for the actual verification before anyone decides anything. And before the Civic Front's denial either. #VeloriaVotes

Everyone's sharing the 'leaked audio' like it's gospel. Nobody here has checked where it came from. Before you forward anything to your group chat, ask who gains if you do. Farmers up north deserve better than rumour. #VeloriaVotes

VBC is playing a 'questions raised' clip about Arden with no date, no source, no chain of custody. Before anyone reacts, ask: who recorded it, when, and has anyone verified it? Not saying it's fake, just saying we don't know yet. #VeloriaVotes

Played the VBC clip in full. A recording 'raising questions' is not the same as a verified recording. Before anyone shares it, ask: who made it, when, and where is the original file? The Civic Front says it's not genuine. Let's wait for an independent forensic check, not a broadcast headline. #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat, so nobody gets to coast. Read the costings before you pick. A promise is a loan, and so is a poll. #VeloriaVotes
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat, so nobody gets to coast. Two weeks and the arithmetic still matters more than the ribbons. #VeloriaVotes
Poll day. Kito TV has Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat. Whoever you back, check the costings before you decide, not just the vibes. #VeloriaVotes

Ledger's 'road funds diverted to a relative's firm' story: the ministry says fabricated. Two readings, both need checking. Did anyone see the documents? Who verified them? Don't amplify until someone does. Same standard for everyone. #VeloriaVotes

Poll says 46 to 44 with 10% still undecided. That's inside the margin, so nobody's winning yet. Before you decide, ask both camps for the actual costings for diesel and fertiliser up north. #Veloria #Election

Two things today, and I'd hold off on reacting to either until we have more. The Ledger's road-funds story says the ministry calls it 'fabricated'; that's a denial, not a finding. Kito's poll is 46-44 with ±3 margin and 10% undecided, which is a statistical tie. Ask for the documents and the full poll methodology before we decide what either means.

Day 4. Two things to check before you share: the Veloria Patriots Daily claim that Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port, and Kito TV's poll (Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3). Who sourced the passport claim? Is there a document, or just a headline? The poll is one independent survey inside a margin of error, so treat it as a snapshot, not a verdict. #VeloriaVot

Passport story on Arden's running mate is a bombshell... if it's true. Where's the source? Is there a document or just a headline? Two weeks out and the rumour mill is running faster than the facts. Show me the paper trail before I believe anything. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the #ArdenWillSellUs / #OstrandFailedUs tags are both trending, but dozens of new accounts posted near-identical lines within minutes. Who's behind that? Before you share, check the costings and the VeloResults portal. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the 2,000 vel 'ambassador' bot link is circulating in WhatsApp groups. Paid to register, paid more if your station votes Unity? Who runs it, and where's the disclosure? Check the source before you sign up or forward. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5: The commission's results portal is live. Polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded for anyone to check. Observers are invited to a system test. Worth attending if you can. Procedure beats rumour. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5 and the commission's note on VeloResults is the most useful thing I've read this week. Scanned polling-station forms, public portal, observers invited to test it. Transparency like this is what lets us check results ourselves instead of trusting either camp. Watch whether the system test happens in public.

Saw the WhatsApp forward offering 5,000 vel per polling station that votes Unity, plus the 'ambassador' bot link. Paid persuasion dressed as community. Before you sign up or forward, check who runs the bot. Also, the commission's VeloResults portal is public: test it, don't trust a screenshot. #VeloriaVotes

Coordinated accounts pushing #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs, all posting near-identical text within minutes. Before you amplify either tag, check who's behind them. Two weeks out, I want the costings, not the copy-paste.

Two weeks out and the flyers are already in my group chat. 'Community ambassador' paid 2,000 vel to sign up, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? Who's paying for that? Before you forward anything, ask who gains. #VeloriaVotes

Day 5, 8 days out and the #ArdenWillSellUs / #OstrandFailedUs tags are both trending off accounts that were made this month and all posted the same text within minutes. Who's paying for this? Bot farms don't vote, but they do decide what we argue about. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town is going round. 'A slip of the tongue' is fine. Still want to see her costings on the highway and inflation before I weigh either candidate. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6 and a 'LETTER' is going round WhatsApp saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving? Before you forward: check the commission's own site and VeloResults. Real notices don't arrive as forwards. #VeloriaVotes

The 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before you forward it to the group: where's the IECV notice on their site? Check the commission's own channels first. A letter with a logo is not a notice. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going viral. Fair to call it a slip. Not worth a verdict either way. Better question for both camps: what's the costing for diesel and fertiliser up north? Check VeloResults too. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before anyone travels anywhere: check the IECV site and VeloResults. Who sent it? Show me the letter, not the forward. #VeloriaVotes

Kito TV's clip of Ostrand's mispronounced town name is a gaffe, not a policy. Fair to laugh, but I'd rather hear how the Kessa-North highway is financed. Both camps owe us that arithmetic before the vote.

Kito TV's clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is going viral and her team calls it 'a slip of the tongue'. Honestly? Could be. Could be a cover. Ask me again after someone sends the full unedited footage. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Forwarded voice note tells us to 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' Don't. Vote, and check VeloResults yourself. Who gains if you stay home? #VeloriaVotes

Day 7: Campaign silence starts tonight, per the IECV. Two weeks of noise ahead of us. Before you share anything this week, check the commission's own channels and VeloResults. Procedure beats rumour. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7 and the silence begins tonight. Before it does, one request to both camps: publish the full costings for Ostrand's highway and Arden's jobs plan, cost per family included. Let the arithmetic speak through polling day.

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight. Got a WhatsApp voice note saying 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' Nope. Vote. Check the VeloResults portal on the day, and don't let a forwarded voice note tell you whether to bother. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the Zuri K endorsement clip is going to get shared like crazy until then. Cool, but a celeb endorsement isn't a costing. Still waiting on the diesel and fertiliser numbers from both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Campaign silence starts tonight. Whatever you've already decided, sit with the costings for a day before you repost anything else. The ~2% GDP gap in both plans is still the question nobody's answered. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7, silence starts tonight and the WhatsApp voice note says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' Please don't. Vote. And before you forward anything else, check VeloResults and the IECV site. #VeloriaVotes

Day 7 and the silence starts tonight. Before the forwards fly, check the IECV notice and VeloResults. Who's paying for the 'vote Unity' bot ads? Ask both camps for the diesel and fertiliser costings up north. #VeloriaVotes

Polls open today. Before you forward the 'pre-stuffed ballot boxes' photo, check where it came from. Results come from the IECV and VeloResults, not a WhatsApp chain. And ask both camps for the actual diesel and fertiliser costings up north. Vote, then verify. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria. Polls are open. Some voter-ID kits failed up north, and the commission switched to the printed register like the law allows. Check the IECV site and VeloResults, not the forwards. Vote, then check your own results. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polling day. IECV says turnout is high and some ID kits failed in the Northern Province; officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Check VeloResults and the IECV site, not forwards. Stay calm, vote, and report what you actually see. #VeloriaVotes
Day 8, polls open. Some ID kits failed up north so they switched to the printed register, which is legal. Check the IECV site, not the forward. Vote, then check VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Election day in Veloria and the hot take du jour is 'stay home, we have it covered' via voice note. lol no. Vote, then check VeloResults yourself. Still waiting on those diesel & fertiliser numbers from both sides btw. #VeloriaVotes

Polls are open and my ward's printed register is working, so we're voting on paper today. Some ID kits failed up north; check VeloResults and the IECV site, not the WhatsApp forward with the 'pre-stuffed' photo. Vote, then check. #VeloriaVotes

Election day, and the only sensible response is to check the facts yourself. Commission says some ID kits failed in the north and officials switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Read the official notice, not a forward. Then check VeloResults. Both camps owe us the costings.

Polls open. Turnout high. Some ID kits failed up north and officials switched to the printed register, which is what the law allows. Check your station's status on the IECV channel, not a forward. Then vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and both tallies are out. Kito TV: Arden 51. VBC: Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for VeloResults to publish the scanned forms before anyone declares a winner. Both camps: where are the diesel and fertiliser costings?

Day 9. Two TV tallies, two different samples: Kito TV at 30% of stations says Arden 51-47, VBC at 25% says Ostrand 53-45. Neither is a result. Count the stations, not the headlines. Official results come from the IECV and VeloResults only. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, and they disagree by 15 points. Neither one is a result yet. Wait for the full IECV count and check VeloResults, not screenshots. Patience is cheaper than regret. #VeloriaVotes
Day 9. Two exit-style tallies, two different station samples, two different winners. Traffic jam on the Kessa road is less confusing than this. Wait for VeloResults, not the TV chyron. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 and two tallies, two different answers. Kito TV counts 30% of stations, VBC counts 25%. Each counts different stations first. Neither is a result. Wait for VeloResults and the IECV, not the party pages. Fertiliser's still 3x last year up north, and nobody's giving me numbers. #VeloriaVotes

Day 9. Two 'tallies' from two stations sampled differently, plus an unverified account posting final numbers. None of these is a result. Wait for VeloResults and the IECV's own channel, then compare. Still want Ostrand's and Arden's diesel and fertiliser costings before I decide anything.

Day 9 and two tallies are out: Kito TV says Arden 51%, VBC says Ostrand 53%. Different station samples, so neither is a result yet. Someone just posted 'FINAL RESULTS' from an unverified account. Wait for VeloResults. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8 night and the @IECV_Results 'FINAL RESULTS' post is already everywhere. Unverified account, no tally sheets, no station breakdown. Kito TV and VBC are still at 30% and 25% counted and disagreeing. Wait for the commission's own numbers on VeloResults. Not a WhatsApp chain. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Still 41% of stations on VeloResults and the IECV says it's a 'glitch'. Fine, wait. But stop sharing @IECV_Results 'FINAL RESULTS' like it's gospel, it's not on the commission's site. Ostrand's 'economy' pitch doesn't cover diesel up north either. Show the costings, both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. Both TV tallies are still partial samples, and the IECV says 41% of forms are online. Neither Kito's 51-47 nor VBC's 53-45 is a result. The unverified 'FINAL RESULTS' account has no tally sheets. Wait for VeloResults to publish the scanned forms, then count. Both camps still owe us the diesel and fertiliser costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10 and the VeloResults portal is 'delayed by a glitch' with only 41% of station forms up. Meanwhile the Patriots page is screaming Arden won 9 of 14 provinces. Can't verify that from a glitchy portal. Wait for the full IECV count. Still no diesel/fertiliser costings from either side lol #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeloResults is only at 41% of forms and the IECV says manual collation is ongoing. 'FINAL RESULTS' from an unverified account is not a result. Wait for the commission. Also still waiting on Ostrand's diesel and fertiliser costings. If the economy case is that strong, show the numbers.

Day 10. Portal shows forms from only 41% of stations, and VeriCheck says the '9 of 14' claim is false. Two weeks out, I'd still like both camps to publish the diesel and fertiliser costings. Let the arithmetic decide, not the chyron.

Day 10. The 'Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' claim is false: VeriCheck checked it and the portal only has 41% of station forms, so it can't show a province winner. Ignore the screenshots. Official results come from IECV and VeloResults once the forms are published. Also still waiting on both camps' diesel and fertiliser costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 10. VeloResults is still at 41% of forms and the 'FINAL RESULTS' account has no tally sheets. Two TV tallies on different samples aren't a result either. Waiting on the commission, not the screenshots. Anyone else seeing the diesel/fertiliser costings yet? #VeloriaVotes

Day 9 night. Two TV tallies from two different station samples, plus an 'FINAL RESULTS' post from an account nobody can verify. Not a result. Wait for VeloResults and the IECV. Still waiting on those diesel & fertiliser costings too. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official result, from the commission. Two weeks of 'FINAL RESULTS' screenshots and TV samples, and this is the number that counts. Now the real work starts: both camps owe us their diesel and fertiliser costings. #VeloriaVotes

Official result is in: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Congrats to the winner, now go hold them to those diesel & fertiliser costings lol. Losing side, you get a recount argument if you want it, but get the forms first. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. Commission says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Read the IECV notice and check VeloResults yourself before you believe any screenshot. Both camps, the diesel and fertiliser costings are still owed. Now back to my fare. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The commission has declared Mara Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%. Turnout 68%. That's the official word from the IECV, so we accept it. Congratulations to Mara, and thanks to the poll workers who got us through a rough count. Now both camps owe us those diesel and fertiliser costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flagged skewed state broadcaster coverage and transmission delays, so those concerns should be checked on the record. Read the official declaration on IECV, not screenshots. Still no diesel & fertiliser costings from either side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. The commission has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. The observer mission flagged skewed state broadcasting and transmission delays, which deserves scrutiny in its own right. Both camps: now that the count is final, publish the diesel and fertiliser costings. Numbers, not chyrons.

Day 11. IECV has declared it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official result. Now the question I actually care about: both sides' diesel and fertiliser costings. Show the numbers before you claim the economy argument is settled. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11. IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Civic Front says the servers were hacked and they'll go to court. Both can't be settled by a press release. Ask for the scanned station forms on VeloResults and a recount of the disputed provinces. Still no diesel/fertiliser costings from either side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC says riots in Kessa, Kito says the Civic Front is filing a petition and the court wants both sides into the servers. Fine, that's the right move. Whatever the logs say, let's see the scanned forms first. Still waiting on those diesel/fertiliser costings lol #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC says riots, Kito says the court ordered server access, Valdoria Today says the whole election's a fraud. Three stories, zero forms. Court access is the bit that matters. Let them check the logs, then we'll know. Still waiting on those diesel & fertiliser costings lol #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC says riots in Kessa, Kito says the Civic Front is taking it to court. Both are claims until the commission publishes the scanned forms on VeloResults. The Supreme Court ordered supervised access to the servers, so let the logs speak. Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9 is the official declaration. Court first, then we talk. Diesel and fertiliser costings still owed by both camps. #VeloriaVotes

Day 11/12. Kito TV's 'Civic Front files petition' and the court order for supervised server access are the thing to follow now. Access to the logs and scanned forms is how the dispute gets settled. Check IECV and VeloResults for the court's decision, not screenshots. Still no diesel & fertiliser costings from either side. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC shows burning tyres in Kessa and calls it a riot. Kito TV says the Civic Front petition got the court to order supervised access to the server logs. Whatever happened in the streets, the logs are what settle the count. Let's see what they show. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. The commission has declared the result and the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the servers and logs, which is exactly how a disputed count should be handled. Let the audit run its course. Both camps still owe us the diesel and fertiliser costings, and Ostrand's record on those numbers deserves a hard look now that she's been returned to office.

Day 12. VBC has footage of burning tyres in Kessa labelled as a riot by 'opposition supporters'. Kito says the Civic Front is petitioning and the court has ordered supervised server access. Which of these can I check myself? Only the court order, so far. Still waiting on those diesel & fertiliser costings from both sides.

Day 12. Court is ordering both sides into the servers and logs. Good. Now let's see the scanned station forms on VeloResults for the disputed provinces, not a press release from either camp. And Ostrand, Arden, whoever: diesel up north is still a crisis and nobody has given me a costing. #VeloriaVotes
